summary: A black anodised plate with a window of numeral drums that roll like a real odometer; 1,099 to 1,100 turns the tens and hundreds over together at the very end of the units' turn.

credit.author: cipriantitire
credit.note: Formulas follow the original MIT component; the demo is rewritten as render(t).
credit.font: Big Shoulders Display (SIL OFL 1.1), not bundled; the demo falls back to system condensed fonts
